mapper.select: SELECT author_id, name, article_cnt, total_voteup, avg_voteup, voteup_rank FROM v_author_rank ORDER BY voteup_rank
SELECT stat_date, follower_cnt, total_voteup FROM author_stat_daily WHERE author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY stat_date
SELECT f.author_id, au.name, au.headline, f.follow_at, f.unfollow_at FROM user_follow f JOIN zh_author au ON au.author_id = f.author_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.follow_at

SELECT a.article_id, a.title, a.url_token, au.author_id, au.name AS author_name, s.voteup_count, s.comment_count, s.version_no, s.captured_at, (SELECT string_agg(t.tag_name, ' · ' ORDER BY t.tag_id) FROM article_tag at2 JOIN tag t ON t.tag_id = at2.tag_id WHERE at2.article_id = a.article_id) AS tags FROM zh_article a JOIN zh_author au ON au.author_id = a.author_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM article_snapshot s2 WHERE s2.article_id = a.article_id ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true WHERE a.author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY a.publish_time DESC
